description: The tools your own connected AI apps and keys ran on your account, newest first: tool name, success or failure, duration, which app. Arguments and results are not stored, so this log says what ran and when, not what data was read. History is kept 90 days. Page with next_cursor.

cursor.description: Value of next_cursor from the previous page.

kind.description: read = only tools that read data, write = only tools that change data. Omit for both.
